title: Same Tree
statement: Return true when two binary trees are structurally identical and have the same node values.
hints: Both nodes null means this position matches.
Exactly one null, or two different values, means the trees differ.

approaches.name: Paired DFS
approaches.explanation: Walk both trees with the same recursion.

editorial: Equality is recursive. Compare the current values, then the left children, then the right children. Short-circuit on the first mismatch. The null cases are what make structure part of the comparison rather than values alone.

examples.explanation: The child is on the other side.
